long_biography.plain_text:
Rockaway Capital emerged from the experience Havrlant accumulated across internet marketplaces, regional e-commerce operations and early technology investing. While studying, he founded the direct-property portal Bezrealitky. After selling it, he joined Allegro Group and led operations across the Czech Republic, Slovakia and the Baltic states. That combination of entrepreneurship and corporate experience became the foundation for the investment group he established in 2013.

Rockaway built and backed e-commerce, travel, media and technology companies, including Mall Group, before broadening into structured investment strategies. Havrlant now leads the group as it develops an asset-management platform covering private equity, venture capital, digital assets and private credit. His approach combines operating involvement with external capital, using experience from company building and exits to select and develop new investments.
